items.source: View technologies that support this contract can obtain an instance to delegate to via RequestContext.getRequestDataValueProcessor().
items.translation: 查看支持此合同的技术可以通过RequestContext.getRequestDataValueProcessor()获取一个用于委托的实例。

items.source:
Implementations may use this contract for example as part of a solution
to provide data integrity, confidentiality, protection against cross-site
request forgery (CSRF), and others or for other tasks such as automatically
adding a hidden field to all forms and URLs.
items.translation: 实现可以使用此合约，例如作为提供数据完整性、机密性、防止跨站请求伪造（CSRF）等问题的解决方案的一部分，或用于其他任务，如自动为所有表单和 URL 添加隐藏字段。

items.source: Invoked after all form fields have been rendered.
items.translation: 所有表单字段渲染完成后调用。

items.source: Invoked when a new form action is rendered.
items.translation: 在新表单动作渲染时调用。

items.source: Invoked when a form field value is rendered.
items.translation: 当表单字段值被渲染时调用。

items.source: Invoked when a URL is about to be rendered or redirected to.
items.translation: 在即将渲染或重定向到某个 URL 时调用。

items.source: additional hidden form fields to be added, or null
items.translation: 要添加的附加隐藏表单字段，或null

items.source: the action to use, possibly modified
items.translation: 要使用的操作，可能经过修改

items.source: the form field value to use, possibly modified
items.translation: 要使用的表单字段值，可能经过修改

items.source: the URL to use, possibly modified
items.translation: 要使用的 URL，可能经过修改
